title: The Impact of Large Language Models (LLMs) on Code Review Process
abstract: arXiv:2508.11034v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently gained prominence in the field of software development, significantly boosting productivity and simplifying teamwork. Although prior studies have examined task-specific applications, the phase-specific effects of LLM assistance on the efficiency of code review processes remain underexplored. This research investigates the effect of GPT on GitHub pull request (PR) workflows, with a focus on reducing resolution time, optimizing phase-specific performance, and assisting developers. We curated a dataset of 25,473 PRs from 9,254 GitHub projects and identified GPT-assisted PRs using a semi-automated heuristic approach that combines keyword-based detection, regular expression filtering, and manual verification until achieving 95% labeling accuracy. translated_title: 大语言模型（LLMs）对代码审查过程的影响
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）近来在软件开发领域获得了显著关注，大幅提升了生产力并简化了团队协作。尽管此前的研究已经考察了针对特定任务的应用，但LLM辅助对代码审查流程各阶段效率的影响仍未得到充分探索。本研究调查了GPT对GitHub拉取请求（PR）工作流的影响，重点关注缩短解决时间、优化各阶段表现以及协助开发者。我们整理了一个包含来自9,254个GitHub项目的25,473个PR的数据集，并采用一种半自动启发式方法识别GPT辅助的PR，该方法结合了基于关键词的检测、正则表达式过滤和人工验证，直至达到95%的标注准确率。随后，我们应用统计建模（包括多元线性回归和Mann-Whitney U检验）来评估GPT辅助与非GPT辅助PR之间的差异。
tldr: 本研究基于25,473个GitHub PR的大规模数据集，通过统计建模系统评估了GPT辅助对代码审查流程各阶段的影响，发现其能缩短解决时间、优化各阶段表现并有效协助开发者。
